_comment: Compiled-in identity constants for the account system (ADR-0029 SR-8). Nothing in a project, a preference or the environment overrides them; the only seam is the loopback test seam of SR-44. gate_mode is warn (notice only) or enforce (refuse); any other value reads as enforce, and an unreadable file falls back to entitlement.DEFAULT_GATE_MODE, which is flipped together with this value. One Supabase project serves development and production (ADR-0029 amendment 2026-10-10), so this file carries its real, public values: URL, publishable key and the Ed25519 public key whose kid matches the ENTITLEMENT_KID function secret. A repository-only auth-config.dev.json, if ever added again for a separate project, is merged in and never packaged (SR-27).
